challenge: Identify Earth Locations that Analog the Permanent Moon Base Locations and Mars

moon.name: Artemis III — Shackleton Connecting Ridge
moon.instrument: NASA LRO LOLA (Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter)
moon.description: High-altitude polar ridge near Shackleton Crater at the Lunar South Pole; characterized by moderate-to-steep slopes, cratered roughness, and persistent solar illumination.

mars.name: Jezero Crater — Western Delta Basin
mars.instrument: NASA MGS MOLA (Mars Orbiter Laser Altimeter)
mars.description: Ancient lacustrine delta deposit explored by the Perseverance rover; features low-angle basin slopes ideal for landing and traversal with moderate boulder roughness.
